name: Challenge GM commands reach a player with a two-word name
contract: The .coa flag, reset and envtest commands read their player as one unquoted word and looked it up by that exact text, so a quoted two-word name was cut at the space and never found; envtest then fell back to the GM who typed it.

Expected: each command accepts the quoted two-word name in any letter case, as .coa trial check already does, and acts on that player. The GM actor has no target, so an envtest answer naming the two-word player proves the name was resolved instead of the fallback.
